messages:
sara.chen: Pushed the tfstate move for workspace=eu-gpu-pools -> backend:azurerm (replicated in westus2). doing validation now, but noticed helm operator getting into a sync loop for gpu-nodepool chart :thinking:
jia.li: which sync loop? saw a few HelmRelease restarts earlier today from the gitops operator logs. any errors?
sara.chen: logs show repeated 409/412 from storage while trying to update release lock. snippet:
```
E0423 14:05:12 kube-controller: failed to update artifact: blob lease lost: 409 Lease ID mismatch
helm-controller: retrying reconcile, attempt=6
```
matt.oconnor: hmm that looks like AZ blob lease contention after the tfstate copy. did we leave both backends writing to same container for a bit?
sara.chen: yeah during the move we had both old s3-proxy and new az backend temporarily pointing at the migration container while rsync finished. probably a window where lease TTLs overlapped. i rolled back the gitops sync for nodepool chart to paused state to stop churn.
jenkins (ops-bot): build/terraform-state-migration #412 completed: moved 12 workspaces -> westus2 (no errors reported) :white_check_mark:
erin-oncall: paused sync was good call. but we still need automated recovery steps so nodepools don't oscillate and waste GPU capacity/cost. any short-term mitigation?
jia.li: we can add a helmrelease annotation to tolerably lock: `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "999"` or set `spec.pause: true` for that resource during state migrations. also can extend blob lease TTL in az CLI while we do the copy: `az storage blob lease acquire` and set duration.
matt.oconnor: longer term we should avoid overlapping writable windows. suggestion: run migration in read-only snapshot mode for consumers (s3 proxy read-only), then atomically switch writers. also add a gate in the gitops pipeline that checks backend migration status (terraform outputs key migrator.done=true) before allowing helm reconciles on infra charts.
sara.chen: agreed. immediate plan: 1) keep nodepool helmrelease paused until 1719313200, 2) run `az storage blob lease renew` for the migration container, 3) patch gitops pipeline to require `tfstate_migration_complete` artifact. i'll open a small PR for the pipeline gate.
erin-oncall: i'll monitor GPU autoscaler metrics and mute alerts for nodepool flapping for the next hour. set a reminder to unpause if still stuck. :ok_hand:
ops-bot: reminder set: unpause nodepool helmrelease at 1719313200 unless `sara.chen` overrides.
sara.chen: created pipeline PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/devops/pipeline/merge_requests/84 -- gate checks storage lease and terraform output. tagging @jia.li for review.
jia.li: reviewing now. also adding a postmortem note to infra/incidents to capture cost hit from churned scale events and recommend an ops playbook.
matt.oconnor: can we also surface a simple boolean in state like `infra/helm_paused_on_migration = true` so other automation knows not to reconcile? avoids ad-hoc annotations.
sara.chen: yeah that's neat. will add to PR. thanks all.
